indicator_name: Weighted Average Rate on Loans Issued by Banks to legal entities, KZT
description: Средневзвешенная ставка по выданным кредитам БВУ юридическим лицам, тенге
methodology: %. Weighted average rate on tenge loans issued by second-tier banks to legal entities during the month, all maturities, from 1997-01. Gaps where the API has no data: 2007-10/11, 2008-08..2008-12, 2009-02..2009-11, 2014-07..2014-12.
